candidates.description: This vector represents fragments of common Hindi words and suffixes.
This feature vector represents common Hindi verb roots, suffixes, and high-frequency monosyllabic morphemes.
These tokens represent Devanagari vowel sign and dependent vowel modifiers attached to punctuation marks.
This vector is related to subword tokens, characters, and fragments of text in Hindi and Devanagari script.
This vector represents conditional, temporal, and relative conjunctions and pronouns in Hindi and related Indic languages.
These tokens represent common suffixes, syllables, or sub-word components frequently found in Hindi vocabulary and text.
This vector activates on various Indic script characters and non-Latin unicode symbols.
This vector represents three-digit numeric values, specifically in the hundreds and low thousands.
This feature vector activates strongly on numeric digits and multi-digit numbers.
These tokens represent various Hindi characters, morphs, and phonetic sub-word components combined with English script fragments.
